hero.title: Your business is unique. Your management platform should be too.
hero.subtitle: NELIAS brings your essential business functions together in a management environment shaped around how your company works.

problem.title: Too many tools. Not enough visibility.
problem.body: Sales in one tool. Inventory in another. Accounting somewhere else. Projects, teams and customer requests scattered across disconnected systems. As businesses grow, disconnected information can slow decisions and multiply manual work.

scattered.title: My information is scattered
scattered.benefit: A unified platform approach for core management workflows.

visibility.title: I lack visibility
visibility.benefit: Shared data foundations and reporting capabilities.

time.title: My teams waste time
time.benefit: Connected workflows and progressively introduced automation.

approach.title: Start with your business, not a software catalogue.
approach.body: Tell NELIAS about your industry, company size, activities and priorities. NELIAS recommends the capabilities and configuration that fit your operations, with room to evolve as your business grows.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: Capture the business profile and operational needs.

compose.title: Compose
compose.text: Recommend a relevant management environment using sector rules.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.text: Add users, capabilities and integrations as needs change.

capabilities.title: Everything your business needs, in one place
capabilities.lead: Customers, sales, inventory, finances and operations - manage your business in an environment shaped around your industry.

industries.title: Different industries. One adaptable platform.
industries.body: From distribution and professional services to manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality and financial services, NELIAS combines a shared foundation and industry-aware configurations.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.text: Select your industry, activities, size, users, legal entities and operational requirements.

steps.title: Review your recommendation
steps.text: See the suggested plan, included capabilities, optional add-ons and integrations.

steps.title: Choose your plan
steps.text: Review a transparent estimate based on plan, capacity and selected options.

steps.title: Run your business
steps.text: Access your dedicated NELIAS environment, complete guided onboarding and evolve over time.

preview.title: See your NELIAS
preview.alt: Illustrative preview of a NELIAS workspace on desktop and mobile

final.title: Build the right environment for your next stage of growth.
final.body: Explore how NELIAS fits your business and find the right configuration for your team.
